def _get_item_length(item, parents_ids=frozenset([])):
    length = 0
    if item is None:
        return 0

    item_id = id(item)
    if item_id in parents_ids:
        return 0

    parents_ids = add_to_frozen_set(parents_ids, item_id)

    if isinstance(item, Mapping):
        for v in item.values():
            length += _get_item_length(v, parents_ids)
        length += len(item)
    elif isinstance(item, strings):
        length = 1
    elif isinstance(item, Iterable):
        for v in item:
            length += _get_item_length(v, parents_ids)
        length += len(item) if hasattr(item, '__len__') else 0
    elif isinstance(item, numbers):
        length = 1
    else:
        if hasattr(item, '__dict__'):
            for v in item.__dict__.values():
                length += _get_item_length(v, parents_ids)
            if not length:
                length = 1
        else:
            length = 1

    return length
